title: Google Pay at checkout
description:
Context: The payment service provider exposes Google Pay in their gateway API (POST /payment-intents with method "google_pay"), and the web checkout can render the button via the PSP's JS SDK. The checkout payment-list flow is the existing integration point.
Reason: Competitors have it and customers keep asking for more payment options at checkout.
Scope: Add the method to the existing checkout payment-list flow. Out of scope: other payment methods, native apps.
acceptance_criteria: Given a browser where the PSP SDK reports Google Pay availability, when the checkout payment step renders, then the Google Pay button is shown; otherwise it is hidden.

Given the customer selects Google Pay, when the payment is initiated, then a payment intent with method google_pay is created and the existing payment flow completes with the order state machine unchanged.

Given a failed or cancelled Google Pay intent, when the failure is handled, then the flow returns to the payment-list step with the previous selection cleared, no order state change, and the failure logged with the PSP correlation ID.
Given the enabled method, when the checkout e2e suite and accessibility checks run, then they pass with the button keyboard-accessible.
epic_context: Payment Platform Expansion — Alternative Payment Methods
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.
